title: Uruguay: a dictatorship in a small country
goal: I can describe the dictatorship in Uruguay and how it ended, using superlatives.

items: I can say what made Uruguay's democracy stand out and how the dictatorship ended, using superlatives.
I can say what happened on 27 June 1973.
I can say what the vote of 1980 showed.
I can use superlatives and give the source of a judgement.
I can use the new words for stable, voter and referendum.
